text:
elaine-sales: Kicking off LatticeBank POC thread. Customer wants Okta SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning for ~50k users, RBAC mapped to org units, and strict domain locking (only *.latticebank.com). Main asks: SCIM throughput/limits, domain proof options, and pricing implications if we need Dedicated. Who can drive tech presales?

sam-se: I can own the SE side. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) SCIM delta vs full sync cadence? 2) Are they doing delegated admin across subsidiaries? 3) Any requirement for JIT provisioning?

elaine-sales: Answers from customer call: 1) They expect near-real-time delta (<=5m for critical groups) but can tolerate 1h for bulk. 2) Yes, multiple subsidiaries with separate RBAC boundaries. 3) Prefer SCIM for provisioning but want SAML assertion mapping for a few partner apps.

priya-ml: Heads-up: near-real-time SCIM at 50k users will push us toward higher throughput and likely Dedicated capacity for the provisioning webhook/backplane. We should measure token churn and list-cache hit rate; caching can reduce load.

aaron-se: For RBAC mapping, we can support claim->role transforms in SAML and SCIM group->role mapping in provisioning. Need to confirm provisioning schema: they have nested groups and custom attributes (department_code). We'll need a mapping table.

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: can spin up a staging Dedicated stack for POC with 2x GPUs and 24hr retention. Use: /deploy poc-latticebank --env staging --dedicated 2xgpus

sam-se: On domain locking: LatticeBank prefers DNS TXT proof for automated renewals. We support both DNS TXT and email-based validation; DNS is recommended for multiple subdomains. Will surface in docs.

elaine-sales: Security questionnaire highlights — pulled from their vendor RFP: MFA for admin console, KMS integration for tenant keys, audit logs for SCIM provisioning events (who/when), and SOC2 attestation. Legal wants responses for data residency too. @legal any blockers?

legal: No showstoppers. Need to confirm KMS provider compatibility (AWS KMS & GCP KMS preferred). Also annotate standard DPA and SCCs for EU workloads. Ask customer where their primary region is.

sam-se: SCIM rate-limit proposal: suggest offering a POC quota of 10 requests/sec with burst to 50 for 5m windows, and advise delta windows >1m to avoid eventual consistency issues. We'll publish recommended retry/backoff sample:

HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30

and a client backoff example.

priya-ml: Pricing angle — if we need Dedicated for stable provisioning and low-latency SAML assertion routing, cost delta vs hosted: roughly 2.5x token/unit baseline for reserved GPU pool for this workload (estimate). Can finance provide a ballpark discount for committed POC month?

elaine-sales: I'll confirm with pricing ops. Action items: 1) @sam-se draft SCIM schema & mapping template for LatticeBank (due EOD tomorrow). 2) @priya-ml estimate Dedicated perf footprint + rough cost delta. 3) @legal send KMS compatibility checklist to customer. 4) @devops-bot provision staging Dedicated POC stack (once SE approves).

aaron-se: I'll start a mapping draft. Quick example snippet for their SCIM push URL and minimal header auth: 

POST /scim/v2/Users HTTP/1.1
Host: poc-api.lrdw.inference
Authorization: Bearer <provisioning-token>
Content-Type: application/json
{  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],  "userName": "j.smith@latticebank.com",  "name": {"givenName":"John","familyName":"Smith"},  "externalId": "12345",  "groups": ["RetailOps"]
}

elaine-sales: Great — keep this thread for updates. I'll loop in the customer once we have the mapping and the KMS confirmation. :thumbsup:
